text:
nora_csm: FYI: Springboard legal ops wants to roll our embeddings+QA into their contract reviews. They want to add 2 teams (Legal Ops & Contract Admin) next month. Early usage shows ~600k tokens/day; they estimate ~1.8M/day after ramp. Any capacity/quotas we need to preempt?

maria_cs: :eyes: Thanks Nora. Do they plan to use hosted or Dedicated? That changes options.

nora_csm: Hosted for now. Concern: latency for long docs. They asked about faster search — might need higher concurrency.

aj_sales: @nora_csm good sign for ARR — great lead. Do we have committed pricing for that volume? If not, want to avoid surprise bill.

ops_bot: Alert: tenant springboard-prod saw 3x requests over last 24h vs baseline. Spike at 14:03 UTC. Logs: `err: none`.

sam_eng: If it's hosted, we can tweak batching and increase `max_concurrency` for their tenant. Quick q: what's the current per-minute QPS?

nora_csm: Current avg 420 QPS, peak 1.3k during ingest runs. They plan nightly batch ingests that may push sustained token rate.

maria_cs: I'll schedule an enablement session for Legal Ops. @sam_eng can you join and walk through embeddings tuning? Prefer Wed 16:00 PT.

sam_eng: Yep, I'll join. Also propose we provision a temporary burst bucket on Dedicated nodes to avoid tail latencies. @ops_team is that doable?

ops_team: We can add a temporary burst policy for tenant:springboard for 48-72h. Need approval from finance if they want committed credits or discounts.

aj_sales: I'll scope the ARR uplift and circulate a quick-term commercial offer. Also flagging renewal — their contract renews in ~10 months; growth reduces risk but we should lock pricing.

nora_csm: Customer feedback: indexing quality on PDFs is inconsistent. They asked for better OCR pre-processing or embeddings fine-tuning. Capturing as a product ticket.

product_pm: Adding ticket PD-7892: PDFs indexing feedback from Springboard. @nora_csm can you attach a sample doc and a failing query?

nora_csm: Done — uploaded samples to the shared drive. Link: https://drive.redwood/springboard/examples :link:

maria_cs: :thumbsup: Action items: (1) enablement Wed 16PT (sam leads), (2) temp burst policy (ops), (3) draft commercial proposal (aj), (4) create eval for PDF indexing (product). I'll own follow-ups.

nora_csm: Assigning myself to run a 2-week usage monitor and share daily digest in this thread. ps: customer asked if we can set `max_tokens` default to 4096 for their tenant.

sam_eng: We can bump token window but depends on model variant. I'll test with `gpt-redwood-extended-4k` and report perf.

ops_bot: Quota increase request submitted by @sam_eng: `POST /customers/springboard/quotas` payload {"burst": true, "tokens": 5000000}. Request id 8f7c.

aj_sales: Putting a 30m sync after enablement to review pricing.

maria_cs: :rocket: Great, thanks team.
